title: Cluedo
learningObjective: A gentle introduction to interactive grader calls and eliminating candidates from feedback;useful before harder query-budget tasks.
priorityReason: A gentle introduction to interactive grader calls and eliminating candidates from feedback;useful before harder query-budget tasks.
ratingNote: Rough CF-scale educational estimate,not an official IOI/CF rating.
ratingBasis: Small separate candidate sets and direct feedback give a short elimination strategy;rough CF1200,not an official rating.

sourceSelectionBasis.note: The grader identifies one incorrect component of a proposed triple;the full-score query budget encourages eliminating that candidate.
sourceSelectionBasis.method: Read public original IOI task document for lightweight educational selection;no original proof,solution audit or code validation claimed.

title: Friend

priorityReason: Reverse construction and compact DP states connect graph structure with weighted independent-set reasoning;best after ordinary tree DP.
ratingNote: Rough CF-scale educational estimate,not an official IOI/CF rating.
ratingBasis: Recognizing how three graph-construction rules combine DP states is a substantial modelling step;rough CF2500.

sourceSelectionBasis.note: Choose a maximum-weight set with no friendship edges in a graph built by three host-based insertion protocols.

title: Tropical Garden
